_comment: Live-action phrasing for the IDs in docs/CINEMATOGRAPHIC_METAPHOR_CATALOG.md. Setups list the IDs they use in shots/setups.json (`conventions`); tools/prompts.py appends `still` phrases to the still prompt (framing and depth only, no motion words) and `video` phrases to the video prompt. The catalog's screen mechanics were written for the vector renderer; these are the same intentions said in camera-department language for a photographed film. Keep one dominant spatial device, one performance device, one material device per setup before adding more.

CAM-APPROACH.video: a slow dolly-in that gathers speed, foreground parallax quickening so the subject grows faster than the background: travel, not a zoom

CAM-WITHDRAWAL.video: a pull-back from one detail to its whole world, the wider field disclosing simultaneous action and scale

CAM-BREATH.video: a damped push and release with the phrase: a small forward lean on the articulation, a slower settle on the breath

CAM-ORBIT.video: a slow arc around the subject, foreground crossing faster than background, the relationship changing as it turns

CAM-PROCESSION.video: a lateral tracking shot, new elements entering at one frame edge as the last leave the other

CAM-ASCENT.video: a crane rise through the layers, near things dropping away until the individuals read as one formation

CAM-DESCENT.video: a plunge toward an aperture, foreshortening accelerating until the opening expands past the frame

CAM-SPATIAL-RUPTURE.video: a dolly-zoom: the subject holds its size while the background perspective stretches or compresses

CAM-ATTENTION-HANDOFF.video: a rack focus that passes attention from one depth to another, the first softening as the second sharpens

CAM-SUSTAINED-REFRAME.video: one continuous slow reframe from a readable anchor to a second anchor, easing across the space while the action continues

CAM-LOCKED.video: locked off on a tripod, the frame never moves

FRAME-CENTRIPETAL.still: curves, gazes and paths all leading inward to one central event

FRAME-CENTRIFUGAL.still: major shapes cropped by the frame edges, the action plainly continuing beyond the frame
FRAME-CENTRIFUGAL.video: elements keep their trajectories before entering and after leaving the frame

FRAME-LENS-CROSSING.still: a large foreground object very close to the lens, partly occluding the scene
FRAME-LENS-CROSSING.video: a foreground object sweeps close past the lens, occludes, and exits an edge

FRAME-NEGATIVE-WAKE.still: a deliberate empty space at the center that the surrounding shapes bend around

FRAME-PERIPHERAL-COUNTERPOINT.still: independent secondary life at the frame edges, partly hidden
FRAME-PERIPHERAL-COUNTERPOINT.video: background action continuing on its own arcs at the edges, never in step with the lead

FRAME-SCALE-BILLING.still: the lead largest and nearest, everything else smaller and farther
FRAME-SCALE-BILLING.video: the lead advances and grows on the strong syllables and eases back on the breath

FRAME-PATTERN-SURRENDER.still: many identical performers arranged into one larger figure: a ring, a spiral, a fan
FRAME-PATTERN-SURRENDER.video: the individuals lock into the pattern on the accent and break out of it after

FRAME-CHROMATIC-TUNNEL.still: concentric colored bands and radial planes filling the frame as the stage itself
FRAME-CHROMATIC-TUNNEL.video: the bands pulse in depth with the percussion

EDIT-GRAPHIC-MATCH.still: a strong central contour that the next shot can match
EDIT-GRAPHIC-MATCH.video: the move ends on the contour the next shot begins with

EDIT-MATERIAL-HANDOFF.video: the outgoing material keeps one contour or gesture while everything else adopts the incoming world

EDIT-CONTEXT-REFRESH.video: by the end of the shot at least two of angle, scale, axis or depth arrangement have changed while the scene stays recognizable

PERF-ANTICIPATION.video: a small contrary preparation before each accent: a draw-back, a compression, a look

PERF-OVERLAP.video: hair, hands, foliage and trailing things settle at their own separate rates after the main mass stops

PERF-ARC.video: every move travels on a curved line of action with a slight overshoot and recovery

PERF-EXAGGERATED-ENUNCIATION.video: the mouth and the head lean overshoot on the strong syllables, then damp

PERF-HYSTERETIC-PRESENCE.video: she rises fast with the voice, holds across the gaps, and only slowly gives the phrase up

PERF-ABSENCE.video: on the breath the performer retreats and another layer inherits the attention

PERF-RESPONSE-CHAIN.video: one thing initiates, another accommodates, the contact gives each an unequal recoil

ANIM-MOVING-HOLD.video: a held pose with internal life: breath, gaze, a strand of hair, one hand; nothing else moves

ANIM-SLOW-IN-OUT.video: moves ease in and ease out, quick through the middle, settling at the pose

ANIM-ANTICIPATION.video: a brief lean or compression opposite the coming move

ANIM-FOLLOW-THROUGH.video: trailing parts overshoot and return after the main mass has stopped

ANIM-SECONDARY-ACTION.video: a small supporting gesture reinforces the main action without stealing it

ANIM-MULTIPLANE.still: foreground, midground and background clearly separated as distinct planes
ANIM-MULTIPLANE.video: the planes move at unequal rates as the camera travels

ANIM-CYCLE-VARIATION.video: the repeated action never repeats exactly: a different entry edge, arc, scale or phase each time

ANIM-IMPACT-ACCENT.video: one hard accent drawn as a single-frame flare, flattening or starburst on the hit

ANIM-SILHOUETTE-STAGING.still: the action readable as a flat silhouette: limbs, features and negative spaces kept separate

GROW-PROPAGATION-WAVE.video: the change travels outward from a source, near things first, farther things later

GROW-GENERATION-CASCADE.video: new growth keeps arriving while the previous growth shifts down and out, never settling

GROW-ENVIRONMENT-ANSWER.video: different parts of the scene answer different instruments: drums trigger the leaves, bass moves the big roots, the voice opens the flowers

DEPTH-MOTION-PARALLAX.video: near layers slide faster than far layers

DEPTH-DYNAMIC-OCCLUSION.video: a near edge uncovers new background on one side while covering it on the other

DEPTH-RELATIVE-SCALE.still: the same motif repeated at several sizes into the distance

DEPTH-SCALE-VELOCITY.video: near objects swell faster than far ones as the camera closes

DEPTH-EDGE-CROSSING.still: near forms cropped by the frame, continuing beyond it

DEPTH-COLOR-ORDER.still: distinct color roles for far, middle and near planes

SONIC-PHRASE-COLOR.video: the light changes color at the phrase boundaries, not continuously

SONIC-MASS-FOLLOWER.video: the big slow things carry the weight of the music: size, glow and mass move slowly, only the fine edges are fast
